description: Capability matrix update: grant/revoke capabilities with the lock-out guard.

cases.log: Capabilities replaced; audit row RolePermissionsUpdated (details { name, before, after }); log "Permissions for role {RoleId} changed by {ActorId}; 2 account(s) to notify."; capabilities-changed notice sent after commit
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Roles: "Quản trị viên" [AdminUsers], "Thư ký" [MeetingCreator], 2 active accounts hold "Thư ký".
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16) with the matrix showing "Thư ký" = [MeetingCreator, VoiceCollector]; the 2 active holders are told their capabilities changed, their sessions stay.

cases.inputs: roleId: <random Guid with no role>; capabilities: [MeetingCreator].
cases.log: Warning log "Permission configuration for role {RoleId} rejected: ...".
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors[roleId] = "Vai trò không hợp lệ."; nothing saved.

cases.inputs: roleId: "Thư ký"; capabilities: [(Capability)999] (a value outside the catalogue).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors[capabilities] = "Danh sách quyền chứa giá trị không hợp lệ."; nothing saved.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
"Quản trị viên" is the only role holding AdminUsers and its only holder is the actor.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors[adminUsers] = "Không thể lưu cấu hình này: sau khi lưu sẽ không còn tài khoản đang hoạt động nào giữ quyền quản trị người dùng, nên không ai vào được màn hình phân quyền nữa."; the matrix is unchanged.

cases.log: Audit row RolePermissionsUpdated; holders of "Quản trị viên" notified.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
AdminUsers is held by "Quản trị viên" and by "Thư ký", which has 1 active holder.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16): "Thư ký" keeps an active account with AdminUsers, so someone can still administer.

cases.log: Error log "Permissions for role {RoleId} changed, but telling its accounts failed."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The change is saved but telling the role's accounts fails (hub unavailable).
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16): the failure is logged, not raised; accounts pick the change up at their next token refresh.

precondition: Roles seeded; admin actor holds role management capability.
